from solution import check_occurences


def test_issue_example_from_description():
    """Example: [(3, 1), (1, 3), (2, 5), (5, 2), (6, 3)] maps to {(1, 3): 2, (2, 5): 2, (3, 6): 1}."""
    result = check_occurences([(3, 1), (1, 3), (2, 5), (5, 2), (6, 3)])
    expected = {(1, 3): 2, (2, 5): 2, (3, 6): 1}  # 2 = 1 + 1, 2 = 1 + 1, 1 = 1
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_empty_list_returns_empty():
    """Empty input has no records so result is empty."""
    result = check_occurences([])
    expected = {}  # 0 records = 0 groups
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_single_sorted_pair():
    """A single sorted pair occurs once."""
    result = check_occurences([(1, 2)])
    expected = {(1, 2): 1}  # 1 = 1 occurrence
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_single_unsorted_pair_normalized():
    """A single unsorted pair is normalized to sorted order with count one."""
    result = check_occurences([(2, 1)])
    expected = {(1, 2): 1}  # 1 = 1 occurrence normalized from (2, 1)
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_reversed_pair_counted_together():
    """Reversed tuples (1, 2) and (2, 1) count as similar times."""
    result = check_occurences([(1, 2), (2, 1)])
    expected = {(1, 2): 2}  # 2 = 1 + 1 reversed occurrences
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_three_copies_same_unordered():
    """Three similar unordered records give count three."""
    result = check_occurences([(1, 3), (3, 1), (1, 3)])
    expected = {(1, 3): 3}  # 3 = 1 + 1 + 1 occurrences
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_distinct_pairs_each_count_one():
    """Records with no similar partner each occur once."""
    result = check_occurences([(1, 2), (3, 4), (5, 6)])
    expected = {(1, 2): 1, (3, 4): 1, (5, 6): 1}  # 1 = 1, 1 = 1, 1 = 1 distinct
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_negative_numbers_normalized():
    """Pairs with negative numbers group when reversed."""
    result = check_occurences([(-1, 2), (2, -1)])
    expected = {(-1, 2): 2}  # 2 = 1 + 1 reversed occurrences
    assert result == expected


def test_issue_self_pair_counts():
    """Identical-element tuple (1, 1) repeated counts each occurrence."""
    result = check_occurences([(1, 1), (1, 1)])
    expected = {(1, 1): 2}  # 2 = 1 + 1 occurrences
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_returns_dict():
    """Example shows the result is a dict."""
    result = check_occurences([(3, 1), (1, 3)])
    expected = {(1, 3): 2}  # 2 = 1 + 1 occurrences
    assert isinstance(result, dict) and result == expected


def test_contract_keys_are_sorted_tuples():
    """Example shows keys are normalized sorted tuples."""
    result = check_occurences([(5, 2)])
    expected = {(2, 5): 1}  # 1 = 1 occurrence with key sorted as (2, 5)
    assert result == expected


def test_contract_values_are_occurrence_counts():
    """Example shows values are integer occurrence counts."""
    result = check_occurences([(1, 2), (2, 1), (3, 4)])
    expected = {(1, 2): 2, (3, 4): 1}  # 2 = 1 + 1, 1 = 1 occurrence
    assert result == expected and all(type(v) is int for v in result.values())
